findings.description: The supplied belief survey file contains 808 rows, while Table 9 reports 807; one row has missing income and is excluded from real-rich subgroup comparisons.
findings.evidence: R translation reports 808 imported rows; subgroup comparison N=807 and extent N=651 match the paper.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the one row without usable income in package documentation.

findings.description: Stata diagnostic commands ksmirnov and bitest were not translated, and the student-specific printed means are not produced by the shipped commands.
findings.evidence: These output values are marked not_checkable.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide reproducible diagnostic output or include exact equivalent calls in the package.

limitations: No Stata executable was available; all reported recomputations are direct R translations.
The Survey 1 upstream wave merge relies on confidential GIP waves not included in the package; the original main file comments out that step and uses the supplied MasterFile_Survey1.dta.
Graphical exports were not recreated; the translated run records payment-bin counts and cell means instead.
Not every printed value in the article body/tables has an individually enumerated result; the checked values cover focal table cells and selected text diagnostics.
